MQTT::collect
Description
This command collects the specified amount of MQTT message payload
data before triggering a MQTT_CLIENT_DATA or MQTT_SERVER_DATA event.
When collecting data in a clientside event, the MQTT_CLIENT_DATA event
will be triggered. When collecting data in a serverside event, the
MQTT_SERVER_DATA event will be triggered.
This command is valid only for the PUBLISH MQTT message type and
allows you to perform various operations on MQTT PUBLISH messages like
modify its contents.
NOTE: Please make sure that MQTT PUBLISH message expects to receive a
payload by using
MQTT::payload length
. This is to make sure that
the payload length is not zero before calling this command.
Syntax
MQTT
::
collect
[
bytes
]
MQTT::collect
Collect the entire payload of the MQTT message. To stop collecting
use MQTT::release command.
MQTT::collect <bytes>
Collect bytes of payload of the MQTT message. If paylaod is smaller
than collect entire payload. The collected data can be accessed via
the MQTT::payload command. To stop collecting use MQTT::release
command.

MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS, MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS, MQTT_CLIENT_DATA,
